name: Guardado's Restaurant
summary: Guardado's official ordering page confirms the 4918 Del Ray Avenue identity and fully enumerates 72 current food and nonalcoholic products across its regular and late-night menus. All 69 frozen rows reconcile once; renamed seafood presentations are normalized, two legacy rows are stale, and current ceviche, sides, drinks, and late-night products are added. All four allergen searches found no matrix or cross-contact policy. Explicit ingredient-based positives are retained without inferring absence.
